messages:
Asha Patel: evening handoff — quick sync before I log off. Few things to watch for tonight:
- Prefetch queue still higher than usual (seen ~125s avg processing). I kicked off a retry job earlier.
- Canary for embed-service is in blue/green rollback state — traffic was shifted at 18:20 and we saw a 3% error bump.
- PR #452 (batching backpressure) needs a quick review — leaving notes inline.

Action items:
- @Dan: please keep an eye on prefetch queue. If >150s for 10m, scale up prefetch-workers by +2.
- @Priya: finish the canary validation checklist and confirm whether to keep or rollback entirely.
- @Marta (SRE): drop a watch if you see any pod restarts in infra namespace.

Short context:
- Retry job: ran at 17:55, workers processed ~6k items, failure rate dropped from 2.1% -> 0.8%.
- Canary: error rate spike correlated with long-tail prompts from a single customer; still investigating.

Dan Brooks: noted. I can take the prefetch watch for the first half of the shift. If I need to scale, I'll run this:
```
# scale prefetch-workers
kubectl scale deploy/prefetch-workers -n infra --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy prefetch-workers -n infra -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
```
I'll post when I scale.

Priya Shah: re canary — running full validation now. ETA ~30m. Early logs show increased latency when kv-cache miss rate > 12%.
I left a comment on PR #452 about improving the backoff on consumer failures.

oncall-bot: Reminder: nightly maintenance window starts 22:00 UTC — load tests will run against canary if it remains active. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Marta (SRE): tagging infra alerts for tonight to the #pagerduty rota. Will also add a short dashboard for prefetch latency to the watch panel.

Dan Brooks: scaled +2 at 2034510000. Observing queue now.

Asha Patel: thanks — two small FYIs before I go:
1) There's a scheduled CRON job change tomorrow morning (db-cleanup) — I linked the PR in the channel; doesn't affect tonight but heads up for handover.
2) If the canary keeps >2% errors after rollback attempt, open a postmortem ticket and link to the canary run id (run/2026-03-17-18:20).

Priya Shah: canary validation complete. Recommend rollback to stable; I've posted the validation snapshot in the PR.

Marta (SRE): added dashboard widget and set an alert threshold: prefetch-avg-latency > 140s for 5m -> pagerduty.

Dan Brooks: queue latency dipped to 98s after scale. Will stay on watch until 02:00 UTC then handover to night shift.

Asha Patel: perfect — I'm signing off. @Dan you're owner for next 6 hours, @Priya on call for canary followups, Marta for infra alerts. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:

Dan Brooks: got it, thanks team.
